title: Zainab tere hussain
body:
matam hai ye meri baqa karte rahenge hum sada
<<DIVIDER>>
zainab tere hussain ka gham karte rahenge
hum seena zani shaam o sahar karte rahenge
<<DIVIDER>>
ay saani e zahra teri sunnat hai ye matam
apne to aqeede may ibadat hai ye matam
har haal may ye farz adaa karte rahenge
zainab tere hussain ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
jis ne teri chadar pe fida kar diye baazu
kehti hai jise bibi alamdar e wafa tu
ghar ghar tere ghazi ke alam sajte rahenge
zainab tere hussain ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
dohrayenge pyase tere asghar ki kahani
ta hashr jise royega darya'on ka pani
har ghoont pe hum yaad usay karte rahenge
zainab tere hussain ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
jo aag liye khaana e zahra pe thay aaye
qayyaam jinho ne tere karbal may jalaye
wo naare jahannum may sada jalte rahenge
zainab tere hussain ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
bibi tere beton ke biradar ke lahoo se
roshan jo huwe aale payambar ke lahoo se
wo deep hawaon may sada jalte rahenge
zainab tere hussain ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
bhoolegi na dunya ye teri dard kahani
jawwad ke lafzein kabhi saadiq ki zubani
pursa tere pyaron ka tujhe dete rahenge
zainab tere hussain ka...
author: Jawad Jaffri
